sources.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi team and kvcache-ai open-sourced AgentENV (AENV) under MIT, as part of Kimi K3 Open Day. It runs agent sandboxes as Firecracker microVMs with millisecond snapshot, resume, and 16-way fork, behind an E2B-compatible API.
